label: HEALING

points.heading: Pause for twenty minutes
points.body: The urge peaks and then fades. Give it time to pass.
points.panel: Set a timer and step away from your phone.

points.heading: Ask what you’re hoping for
points.body: Comfort? An answer? Closure? Name it first.
points.panel: “What do I really want this text to do?”

points.heading: Respect what he asked for
points.body: If he asked for space or no contact, honoring that respects you both.
points.panel: “I can miss him and still not reach out.”

points.heading: Write it somewhere else
points.body: Put the words in your notes app, not your messages.
points.panel: Write the text in a journal, then decide tomorrow.

points.heading: Text a friend instead
points.body: The feeling needs somewhere to go. Let it go to someone safe.
points.panel: “I really want to text him. Talk me through it?”

close.save: Save this for the 2 a.m. moments.

caption:
The urge to text an ex can feel impossible to ignore, especially late at night.

You don’t have to fight the feeling. You just don’t have to act on it right away. These five steps give you a little space to decide what you actually want, calmly.
